collection.title: BMW 4 Series Coupe 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 4 Series Coupe 2013 - 2019 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
